identity.name: BondFlow Pro
principles: Density is Clarity: Financial pros need data, not fluff.
Color is Signal: Use color only to indicate status (Profit/Loss/Active).
Typography is Interface: The numbers are the UI.
Grid is Law: Everything aligns perfectly.

usage.headings: Use Manrope for all section titles. Weight: 700 or 800. Tracking: tight.
usage.body: Use Public Sans for labels, instructions, and general text. Weight: 400/500.
usage.data: CRITICAL: Use JetBrains Mono for ALL financial figures, dates, and percentages. This ensures tabular alignment.

usage_rules.primary: Main navigation, active states, primary buttons.
usage_rules.accent: Call to actions, active links, focus rings.
usage_rules.surface: Backgrounds for sidebars or secondary panels.

style_guide.inputs: h-10 bg-white border-input focus:ring-2 focus:ring-accent focus:border-accent transition-all font-mono text-sm

custom_components.name: MetricCard
custom_components.description: A dense card for displaying a single key metric (e.g., IRR, Price).
custom_components.style: bg-white border border-border p-4 flex flex-col gap-1 hover:border-accent/50 transition-colors

visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay on the sidebar only.

assets.icons: Use lucide-react. Preferred icons: Calculator, TrendingUp, DollarSign, Calendar, PieChart, Activity.

instructions_to_main_agent.general: You are building a high-precision financial tool. Accuracy and clarity are paramount. Do not use 'cute' UI. Make it look like a modern Bloomberg terminal.
layout_rules: Always use a sidebar layout for the main dashboard.
The 'Bond Creation' form should be a multi-step process or a clean, segmented single page.
The 'Cashflow Timeline' must be a visual chart (Bar/Line) AND a detailed table below it.
Use 'sonner' for all notifications (e.g., 'Bond Created', 'Calculation Updated').

component_overrides.Card: Remove shadows. Use 1px borders. Add 'hover:border-gray-400' for interactivity.
component_overrides.Button: Use 'default' variant for primary actions (Save, Calculate). Use 'outline' for secondary. Avoid 'ghost' unless in a menu.
component_overrides.Input: Ensure inputs are large enough for easy clicking but text is 'text-sm'. Use 'font-mono' for all numeric inputs.

universal_guidelines: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur)
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯📚🎭🎬🎪🎉🎊🎁🎀🎂🍰🎈🎨🎰💰💵💳🏦💎🪙💸🤑📊📈📉💹🔢🏆🥇 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed
Examine existing components to understand the project's component patterns before creating new ones
Components MUST use named exports (export const ComponentName = ...)
Pages MUST use default exports (export default function PageName() {...})
Use sonner for toasts. Sonner component are located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx
